scope: float64 offline algebra and physical controls only; not GPU/Rain acceptance

protocol.scope: Offline analytical controls only; no GPU work or production changes during controlled performance batch. Candidate addresses cone/point coupling identified by rejected angular-frame refresh.
protocol.equations: K=J M^-1 J^T for point XYZ and cone row; softness Gamma has point block Kpp*zp/yp and cone diagonal Kcc*zc/yc. Solve (K+Gamma) delta=-(Jv+b+Gamma*old). Enforce accumulated cone impulse>=0 by two active sets; if clamped, solve point equations with delta_cone=-old_cone.
acceptance: Independent full 4x4 active-set solution agrees with Schur-complement result within1e-10
Point stationarity, cone complementarity and nonnegative accumulated cone impulse within1e-10
For zero bias and hard constraints, corrected kinetic energy does not exceed pre-warm baseline by1e-10
Action/reaction preserve linear and angular momentum about coincident anchor by1e-10
Uncoupled limit reproduces original scalar/vector softness update within1e-10
protocol.limits: Does not prove float32 GPU behavior, rotating cache transport, full-scene acceptance, or resolution of Rain. No relaxed physical thresholds. Current prepared-axis and refreshed-axis candidates must retain full replay cone/twist/anchor checks.
